subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: The achievement did not pop for one player because the main character's inventory was full and the Charm went into another character's inventory.

evidence.quote: This achievement didn't pop for me because the main character's inventory was full and the Charm defaulted into another character's inventory.

subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: Reloading the save and making sure the character holding the Charm had a free inventory slot fixed the problem.

evidence.quote: I just reloaded my save and made sure he had a free slot  and it was fine.

subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: If the achievement does not pop, repeatedly trading the Charm between the three characters eventually makes it pop.

evidence.quote: if this happens just keep trading the charm between the three characters over and over and eventually it will pop.

subject: Refuse father's offer
text: Say no once to get the achievement, then say yes afterwards to complete the game without repeating the boss fight.
